text.name: Axe of Legends
text.description:
{Axe of Legends}

Increases the hero's Attack by 4. All friendly targets do +20% damage.
text.event: Behind a hedge overgrown with ivy, you saw a dilapidated house. Having made your way through the bushes, you climbed into the house through the window. The air inside was stale. Here you stumbled upon the skeleton of the former owner of the house. Above him on the wall hung a magnificent Axe of Legends. Maybe it's not just an accident that you found it right now?
